pages.text: When placing a Magic Center, choose any odd radius from 3 through 101. The center's - and + controls also change the radius by 2.$(br2)Placement applies Bleeding for a number of seconds equal to the chosen radius.

The radius determines two things:$(br2)$(li)The area in which magic circles are detected and powered$(li)The base fuel consumption rate (larger radius = more fuel per minute)$(br2)Magic circles must be within the center's radius horizontally and within +/- 3 blocks vertically to be counted.
